entities.summary: Roger Olsson was a Swedish ice hockey center and Olympian. Olsson played all seven matches with Team Sweden at the 1968 Winter Olympics and scored one goal. He previously played for VIK Västerås HK and Frölunda HC in the Swedish Elite League.
